intermediate.name: Côte du Haut Pichot
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (3) Côte du Haut Pichot (179.3 km)

story: A rainy day saw the break of the day being caught 52km out from the finish. Two short and steep climbs in the final 12km caused an elite group of about 30 riders to sprint for victory, which was taken by favorite Matthieu van der Poel.
